references.text: Esau settled in the Seir Mountains, confirming that Esau's descendants lived in this area.
Here the Horites are mentioned as the original inhabitants of Seir before Esau's descendants drove them out.
The Horites in the Seir Mountains are mentioned, showing that they lived there before Esau's descendants took over the land.
The Lord gave the Seir Mountains to Esau's descendants as their possession.
Parallel passages describe how Esau's descendants drove out the Horites and settled in their place, just as Israel was to do with their land.
Joshua confirms that Esau received the Seir Mountains as his inheritance.
Esau lived in Seir, in the land of Edom, confirming the connection between Esau's descendants and this area.
